text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual meets Malian counterpart.
- Politicians to form party of "Revolutionary Family" in February. The Revolutionary Family aims to rally former nationalist fighters and sons of those killed in Algeria's independence war.
- University teachers' union and ministry officials fail to reach accord over pay.
- University teachers' union calls for a protest on January 5.
- Union representatives for workers begin talks over salaries with government officials ahead of a joint meeting between government and the Union Generale des Travailleurs Algeriens (UGTA).
- Zeroual issues order to government bodies demanding implementation of the constitution voted last November.
- Algeria's Armed Islamic Group (GIA) has sent a letter to French President Jacques Chirac threatening more attacks in France.
